propositions: Production bugs resulted from store write paths bypassing canonical write seams by issuing raw git add/commit/rm operations outside the sanctioned transaction and reconciler APIs

A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST for subprocess mutations + workflow/shell for tracker-context git operations) must flag unmarked raw git mutations and accept only inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' markers with mandatory reasons

The lint must distinguish between three write classes: seam-wrapper internals (gitutil.run_git/run_git_write, event_append._run_git, txn, purge_bridge, git_adapter, _ref_lock), store-maintenance commands calling per-module _git wrappers (delete, compact, txn, init, fsck variants), and disposable-workspace repos (eval_solver, criterion_preview, review_bot/gerrit_client, opcert_service/workspace)

Variable-argument tracking within function scope (local list literals, splatted arguments, opaque forwarding) must be resolved to catch idioms like 'args = ["commit"]; run_git(*args)', while cross-function or dynamic argv construction remains as accepted residual
Report-mode bootstrap must inventory all hits before enforcement, with every hit either remediated or marked with a reasoned marker in the same change; marker-without-reason must fail the lint
